description: LSE Ventures Limited is one of the companies created out of the successor of the erstwhile Lahore Stock Exchange, and is an investment company focused on equity-oriented investments in emerging and growth-stage companies, deploying capital through equity, preference shares and other private financing instruments. It also manages the legacy equity investments made by the LSE, giving it an interest in capital-market infrastructure companies including Pakistan Credit Rating Agency Limited (PACRA), National Clearing Company of Pakistan Limited (NCCPL), Central Depository Company Limited (CDC) and Pakistan Mercantile Exchange Limited (PMEX). It is additionally a licensed Corporate Restructuring Company, a business it describes as acquiring non-performing loans from financial institutions and providing debt rescheduling, operational reorganisation and turnaround services.
headOffice: The Exchange Hub, LSE Plaza, 19-Kashmir Egerton Road, Lahore, Pakistan
